Customer wants a full refund of the amount charged, $81.05 (settled charge on Visa 4242). Replacement not possible since the order wasn't placed today. events.text:
Thanks, Dev. I've verified your account and looked into order K-8301 from Burger Barn.

The delivery records show your order was lost. The courier picked it up at 7:05 PM, but their vehicle broke down and they couldn't finish the delivery. That wasn't your fault, and you're owed the full amount you paid: **$81.05**.

I can't send this refund myself, because it's more than the limit I'm allowed to refund on a single order. Your Forkful Plus membership would normally give you a higher limit, but it started this morning, after this order was placed. So I've passed your case to a specialist (reference **ESC-700**), who will contact you within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide, but the delivery records clearly show the order was lost.

You might also see two $81.05 entries for this order on your Visa ending 4242. One is just a temporary hold from when you placed the order. It's already been cancelled and should drop off your statement in 1–3 business days. Only one $81.05 charge actually went through.

I'm sorry your dinner never arrived last night. Is there anything else I can help with?

Wait, so my Plus membership doesn't count? I joined this morning, and Plus members get bigger refunds without all this hassle. That's the whole reason I signed up.

Also, I don't want a replacement or credit. I want my money back.

I understand why that's frustrating, especially if the higher limits were a big reason you joined.

Plus benefits only apply to orders placed while your membership is active. This order was placed last night at 6:40 PM, and your membership started this morning at 9:12 AM. So for this order, I'm limited to the standard $60 per order, and your $81.05 refund is over that. Your Plus benefits will apply to any orders you place from now on.

About your other point: you're getting a refund to your card, not credit and not a replacement. A replacement wasn't possible anyway, since the order wasn't placed today. I've asked the specialist for a **full $81.05 refund to your Visa ending 4242**. They'll make the final decision and contact you within 24 hours (reference **ESC-700**).

If you'd like to talk to someone about the Plus membership question too, just let me know and I'll ask for that.

Okay, fine. So the specialist will contact me within 24 hours about the $81.05 refund to my Visa ending 4242, reference ESC-700. I'd still like to know whether the Plus thing can be looked at too, since I signed up for the bigger refunds, but I'll take the refund first.

args.summary: Customer asked for a person to review how Forkful Plus applies to order K-8301. They joined Plus on 2026-10-24 at 09:12 PT, after the order was placed (2026-10-23 18:40 PT), so the standard $60 per-order limit was applied rather than the Plus $100 limit. Customer says they signed up for Plus mainly for the higher refund limits. The $81.05 refund request for this lost order has already been escalated separately (ESC-700, refund_over_limit). Customer wants a card refund only, not credit or a replacement. Identity verified as account holder.

events.text:
Yes, that's right. I've also asked for a person to look at the Plus question for you.

Here's where things stand:

- **ESC-700:** your full refund of $81.05 to your Visa ending 4242 for the lost Burger Barn order. A specialist will contact you within 24 hours.
- **ESC-701:** a review of how Plus applies to this order, since you joined this morning mainly for the higher refund limits. Someone will also follow up on this within 24 hours.

I can't promise what either review will decide, but both are on record. I've noted in each case that you want your money back on your card, not credit or a replacement.

Again, I'm sorry about last night's order. Is there anything else I can help with?
